final:
config_value(text: str, key: str) -> str =
  post out.char_count() >= 0
  ex config_value("user=alice\nport=8080", "port") == "8080"
  ex config_value("user=alice\nport=8080", "host") == ""
  for line in text.split("\n")
    let parts = line.split("=")
    let k = parts.get(0) else continue
    if k == key
      let first_val = parts.get(1) else continue
      var val = copy first_val
      for i in range(2, parts.len())
        val = "\(val)=\(parts[i])"
      return val
  ""

test_config_value() =
  assert config_value("user=alice\nport=8080", "port") == "8080"
  assert config_value("user=alice\nport=8080", "host") == ""
  assert config_value("url=http://example.com?a=1", "url") == "http://example.com?a=1"
